name: All 18 original adaptations are separate from 44 deterministic engineering nodes
FPS cap validates 30 through 240 and the final Unlimited position
Eco CPU mode reduces body budgets and animation switches remain independent
Custom signals sanitize text, reject remote media and preserve allowed shapes
Sandbox grants AP, RP, raw material, DNA and water without touching journey slots
Manual projectile collision hits a real intervening rock even without a selected target
Manual projectiles also hit rival bodies
Personal laser removes rock integrity over time and obeys heat lockout
Horizon mining removes stored disk matter before awarding raw ore
Guardian assembly spends real core mass and raw material, then follows a bound trajectory
Structured galaxies contain stellar parents, real planetary children and finite belts
Boss gauntlet has finite progression, real damage and one reward per defeat
Salvage expedition surveys all sites and consumes real delivered material
Scenario state, aim-independent boss angle and new settings survive save/load
Repeated restarts reset command timers, projectiles, taunts and pooled drone state
